title: Two-step circuit-machine transition
statement: Let $z$ be a Boolean word, let $i+2\le |z|$, and suppose its entries at positions $i$ and $i+1$ are $b$ and $b'$. If the symbol pair determined by $b,b'$ is $s$, then, for either setting of the exactness parameter, the circuit-evaluation machine started in phase $\mathrm{rd1}(\phi)$ at input position $i+1$, with value and mark tapes $v_t,m_t$, both work heads at $j$, and empty output, reaches after exactly two steps the configuration at input position $i+3$ whose state, tape contents, head positions, and output are given by the local action for phase $\phi$, symbol $s$, and scanned tape values $v_t(j),m_t(j)$.
hypotheses_covered: the pair symbol determined by $b,b'$ equals $s$
the value and mark tapes are integer-indexed partial Boolean tapes
the work-head position $j$ is an integer
